name: Nevada
overview: Nevada issues big game tags for every species except mountain lion through an online computerized draw at ndowlicensing.com (a few special tags, such as Heritage auction, Dream Tag raffle and landowner tags, are issued outside it); the main draw application period ran March 23 to May 13 in 2026, followed by a second draw in June and First-Come, First-Served leftover tags in July. Applicants pick up to 5 hunt choices (hunt number and unit group) per species category, and each application gets bonus points squared plus one draw numbers, so points improve but never guarantee odds. Unsuccessful applicants earn one bonus point per species category per year with an active license, and resident/nonresident quotas are split roughly 90/10.

species.drawSystemSummary: Nevada's draw gives each applicant one draw number for the application plus bonus points squared (BP² + 1 chances); the lowest random number assigned is the one used, and tags are awarded from the lowest number up. Antlered mule deer tags are drawn by hunt number and unit group (up to 5 choices); junior hunts are drawn before general antlered tags.
species.residentNote: Resident hunts: 1331 (any legal weapon), 1341 (archery), 1371 (muzzleloader), junior hunts 1105/1106/1107. No waiting period for mule deer.
species.nonresidentNote: Nonresident hunts 1332, 1342, 1372 in the main draw, plus the separate Restricted Nonresident Guided Mule Deer Hunt (1235, must hunt with a licensed guide) drawn in March. Resident/nonresident quotas are set at about 90%/10% (Commission Policy 24, per NDOW FAQ).
species.otcSummary: No over-the-counter tags; leftover tags from the second draw may be sold First-Come, First-Served from about early-mid July.

Elk depredation hunts 4102/4107 for 2024-2025 come from NDOW Hunt Data (choice 'all') because no bonus point report was published for them. Draw years 2022-2025: NDOW posts each year's bonus point reports and Hunt Data the following winter, so 2026 draw statistics were not published as of 2026-10-31. Records with choice 'first' are 1st-choice applicants and 1st-choice successful applicants from NDOW's bonus point reports (odds computed); quota is the main-draw quota printed there and can be slightly below the commission-approved quota (shown in the note when NDOW Hunt Data differs).
